title.narrative: Heritage and Identity for Ahmadi’s sustainable development- Phase I

description.narrative: The project aims to preserve Ahmadi’s heritage while fostering sustainable urban regeneration and cultural engagement. Aligned with Kuwait Vision 2035, the project aligns with the National Council for Culture, Arts, and Letters (NCCAL) mandate to safeguard Kuwait’s heritage, promote creative industries, and enhance social inclusion. Using UNESCO’s Historic Urban Landscape (HUL) approach, it will integrate heritage conservation with urban fabric, infrastructure improvement, and community participation
